representationNotes.commentary: Source summary orders phases as Reconnaissance, Exfiltration, Credential Access, Discovery, while event timestamps show overlapping and interleaved activity. Phase order preserved from source wording.

Attack graph edge says 'exfiltrated to proddata001' while timeline and summary describe data staged to cloud storage and exfiltration from customer-pii. Relationship rel2 retains source wording at storage-account level without resolving destination/source inconsistency.
Attack graph label 'enumerated public co' appears truncated. Normalized as public container enumeration in relationship labels where supported.
Schema lacks first-class container and blob URL resource subtypes and lacks explicit SAS credential type; represented as cloud-resource, data-asset, and other respectively.
representationNotes.suggestedVocabularyExtension: Add entity types for blob-container, blob-object-url, and sas-token

representationNotes.commentary: Alert IA-ALERT-002 states 19 PutBlob operations to app-logs, customer-pii, database-backups, but provided timeline examples show deployments and public-assets writes. Model preserves both by summarizing as source-reported without reconciling exact target set.

Alerts IA-ALERT-003, 004, 006, and 007 all share the same summary and are linked to four sign-in events. Source does not map each alert to a specific sign-in record; model associates each alert to the set of four related events.

Source uses statuses Compromised and Affected plus phrases such as 'resource involved in credential access' and 'targeted during collection'. These are retained in descriptions; schema does not directly encode all involvement semantics beyond status/role/relationships.
